purpose: Teach: 柔軟性/それだけに/試す/ディフェンス/冠/ビジュアル/レコーディング/引き分け

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ヨガのおかげで、体の柔軟性、上がったよ、最近。
lines.en: Aoi, thanks to yoga my flexibility has really improved lately.
lines.style: Warm, genuine observation. Light brightness in the delivery—pleased but not performative. Soft landing on the end, inviting her in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。久しぶりだもんね、それだけに、会えて嬉しいよ、メイちゃん。
lines.en: Yeah. It's been so long, that's why I'm really happy to see you, Mei.
lines.style: Sincere and tender. Gentle recognition of the time apart. Leans into the affection without making a show of it. Breath easy, no hurry.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 新しいレシピ、試すの、楽しみだよ、葵、お願いね。
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to trying out this new recipe with you, Aoi—will you help?
lines.style: Hopeful and light. A quiet invitation more than a question. Soft emphasis on the anticipation. Open at the edges, genuine eagerness underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うちの弟、サッカーで、ディフェンス担当だよ、頑張ってる。
lines.en: My brother plays defense in soccer, actually—he's been working really hard at it.
lines.style: Proud, conversational shift. The word 'defense' lands with a little weight—she's noticed his commitment. Warm but matter-of-fact, the way you talk about someone you're rooting for.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お友達の結婚式、冠を被せる演出、感動的だったわよ。
lines.en: My friend's wedding was so moving—the way they did the ceremony with the crown was beautiful.
lines.style: Softly reflective, touched. The memory sits in her voice. Slower pace on the image. Quiet wonder at the end, still processing the emotion of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店のロゴ、ビジュアル、新しくしたよ、可愛いでしょ?
lines.en: We redesigned the store's logo and branding—look, it came out pretty cute, right?
lines.style: Upbeat, a note of pride mixed with playfulness. Inviting her opinion genuinely. Light energy without being scattered. The expectation of a 'yes' is soft, not pushing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 歌手の彼、レコーディング、最近、忙しいって、聞いた。
lines.en: I heard her boyfriend the singer has been really busy with recording lately.
lines.style: Gentle observation, a little distant. Not urgent—just noting something she's picked up on. Thoughtful tone, the careful noticing of someone who cares but won't push.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日の試合、引き分け、けっこう、悔しかったよね。
lines.en: Yesterday's game ended in a draw, and honestly, we were pretty frustrated about it.
lines.style: Reflective, a trace of disappointment held lightly. The frustration is real but not dwelling—she's moved past it mostly. Exhales a little on the admission. Shared disappointment, not complaint.
